messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up from today's vendor-induced outage (cloud-region spike -> model-registry auth errors). Capturing owners and sprint windows so this doesn't recur.
ops-bot: Incident #2026-0423 created (severity: P2) — linked runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/incident/2026-0423 :memo:
sam: thanks — can we list the concrete remediation items and owners? want to slot into next sprint planning. :calendar:
maria: yep. TL;DR of root causes: (1) cloud region control-plane rate-surge caused auth token refresh failures for model-registry client; (2) model-registry's auth TTL fallback was misconfigured so retries saturated upstream; (3) no synthetic canary for token refresh on dedicated infra.
taylor: proposed actions: 1) add tenant-scoped token retry/backoff with jitter (owner: taylor) — due EOD next Tue; 2) add an auth TTL sanity check in model-registry and default-safe TTL (owner: sam) — due in sprint 13; 3) synthetic canary that exercises token refresh and model pull on all regions (owner: anna) — PoC by Fri, full rollout next sprint.
kevin: +1. Also add vendor SLA follow-up: ask cloud vendor for control-plane surge postmortem and request a mitigation play for control-plane rate limiting. owner: kevin. due: 2 weeks. :phone:
sam: for the model-registry sanity check, do we prefer a feature-flag rollout or an immediate patch?
taylor: feature flag for the safe default, immediate patch for the config bug. small patch will be gated behind canary.
maria: going to centralize these into the postmortem action tracker. Quick list I'm adding now: 
- ACTION-001: Token refresh backoff & jitter in client lib (owner:taylor, eta: 2026-04-28, status: in-progress)
- ACTION-002: Model-registry TTL fallback + auto-heal (owner:sam, eta: 2026-05-07, status: todo)
- ACTION-003: Synthetic token-refresh canary across regions (owner:anna, eta: 2026-04-24 PoC, full rollout: 2026-05-14)
- ACTION-004: Vendor SLA & surge mitigation ask (owner:kevin, eta: 2026-05-07)
- ACTION-005: Alerting tweak: surface token refresh latency > 2s as P99 (owner:maria, eta: 2026-04-26)
(please ping if ETA's conflict with sprint commitments)
anna: adding: canary should run against both dedicated and hosted endpoints. PoC will be a lightweight lambda with `curl` to the refresh endpoint every 5m. example snippet: ```curl -i -X POST https://registry.internal/refresh -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' -d '{}'```
kevin: also suggest adding regression test in our CI that simulates control-plane 429s to the auth flow. we should verify graceful fallback. owner: kevin. eta: 2026-05-01.
sam: noted — I'll slot ACTION-002 into sprint 13 backlog and mark it as high-priority. can someone own cross-team validation with platform-sre?
taylor: I can coordinate with platform-sre on the rollout gating and create the canary alert docs. tagging @platform-sre in the tracker.
maria: on recurring patterns — ops data shows small auth blips monthly for past 4 months during region maintenance windows. we should add a recurring monthly resilience drill for token path. proposed owner: ops-sre rotation; cadence: monthly, first drill: 2026-05-05. :repeat:
sam: who will track closure? can we have a weekly 15m sync until the big items are closed?
maria: I'll run the weekly 15m triage (Mon 09:15PT) until everything is green. will update the tracker after each sync. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Reminder created: "weekly-postmortem-triage" every Mon 09:15 PT, invited: maria, sam, taylor, kevin, anna.
anna: quick question — do we need a DB migration for TTL fallback?
taylor: no migration; config-only with a safety toggle. but we'll run a read-only validation sweep during canary.
kevin: vendor comms: I'll request durable contact with their infra on-call and ask for a scheduled quarterly joint-run drill.
sam: sounds good. please put vendor contact + correspondence into the tracker (sensitive: mark internal-only).
maria: final ask: owners, please add estimated engineering hours to each ACTION so we can decide whether to pull into current sprint or make a small hotfix sprint. I'll accept updates in the tracker or ping me here.
kevin: I'll log hours for ACTION-004 and ACTION-006 (CI regression).
taylor: ACTION-001 hours: 8h. ACTION-006 (canary docs): 4h.
anna: ACTION-003 PoC: 6h.
sam: ACTION-002: 12h.
maria: thanks all — will close this thread after I create the canonical tracker entry and link it to the postmortem doc. please react with :eyes: when you've reviewed your assigned items.
taylor: :eyes:
kevin: :eyes:
